confirmed_causes: Moli JavaScript quotes: author/tag fields concatenated

Lightpanda Node README: middle section absent
Kitesurf MDN History API and Cache pages: required tail sections absent

latest_main_impact.rerun: The changed Django tutorial reference was independently frozen and rerun for all five methods; Moli returned browser_exit. Other calls were retained only under exact reference-byte and evaluation-scope equivalence.

limits: Manual review validates the declared references and task contracts. It does not establish factual freshness for volatile values outside those contracts or statistical repeatability from one call per URL.
